title: Otori Emu — The Barbeque Magistrate?!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Lodge Classroom

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Sneaky, sneak...
Okay, the coast is clear.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And I've got everything I need. Let's go!
bgm_area00004
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Miku, I'm here!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Emu, welcome!
Are you done with practice?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! I'm free until dinner♪ It felt like the right time to set up our little surprise!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Cool! I hope they all like it☆

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Looks like they're just wrapping up with practice!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Thanks, Miku!
Then let's...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hey, you guys! Happy wonderhoy♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Why are you here?! Aren't you supposed to be at the Seaside School?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Yup, and it's been a ton of fun so far♪ But I had some free time, so I decided to visit.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I told my groupmates that I'd be gone for a little bit, so I'm free until dinner!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, okay.
As long as they know, I guess...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Welcome back, Miku.
And welcome to you too, Emu.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Miku's told us all about how she's been visiting you. Thank you for keeping her company.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, it's been super fun with her around♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, and...!
There's something I've been wanting to tell you guys♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, are you here to tell us some stories?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, right.
I was under the impression that you'd tell us after you actually got home...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But there's so much to talk about already. I couldn't wait until then!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
First, let's start with...!
How I'm in the same group as Saki and Honami.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, you mean Tsukasa's sister? And I believe her childhood friend as well?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wow! That's incredible!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I know, right?! And our number one fan, Kohane, is in our group too! You know, the really really cute girl I've been talking about♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, the one we always see at our shows?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! Today, we practiced swimming together! After that, we had a class versus class watermelon smashing competition...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. It's only your first day and you've already done so much.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I get why you couldn't wait until later.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I understand as well.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
And there's lots more still to come♪
Right, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup! And check this out☆
I brought some shells that Miku and I found on the beach!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, cowrie shells, noble scallops... And I believe the translucent one there is a chlamys irregularis.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wow, I can't believe you were able to find so many different kinds...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I even brought the biggest and prettiest one we found♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Here it is!
A big conch that barely fits in my hand! I got it just for you, Nene☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Wow, that is pretty big!
It's been sun-bleached white really nicely too...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Are you sure I can have this?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! You can hear the ocean if you put it over your ear too♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay. In that case...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, I can hear waves crashing on the beach! It sounds so real...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Right?! Isn't it awesome?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm guessing you know how that actually works, Rui.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, well...
But...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Just as Emu brought back some stories from the beach for us to hear...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This conch might've saved the sounds of the sea so that it could be brought back for us to hear as well, no?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see. That's a wonderful way to put it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, it is.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh no, sorry! I need to get back soon!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thank you for what you've shared with us, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I hope your next two days are just as fun.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, I believe she's just getting started.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Right! Have as much fun as you possibly can! And please look after Saki for me!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I will! Saki and I are gonna have a blast creating fun memories together!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I'll come visit again soon, Emu!
So I'll see you then!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup!
